entities.summary: Allende and the Chilean Road to Socialism, a transformative movement in Chile (1970–1973). Emerged from Arturo Alessandri Palma's populist presidency and the 1925 Constitution and Socialist Republic. Catalyzed Copper nationalization — 'Second Independence,' July 11, 1971 and Military coup — Allende dies in La Moneda, September 11, 1973.
